title: This Spider Lassos Up to 8 Moths a Night With Fake Perfume

scenes.text: This spider fishes for moths with a ball of glue.
It's a bolas spider. It dangles a sticky drop on a silk line and swings it like a lasso.
But the real trick is the smell. The glue gives off the scent of a female moth.
Males follow it straight in, thinking they've found a mate.
One spider can catch up to eight moths in a single night.
A fishing line, a lasso and a perfume. All in one spider.

description:
A bolas spider catches moths with a sticky ball on a silk thread that smells like a female moth.
The female spider swings the sticky drop at flying males lured in by the fake scent, and can catch up to eight moths in one night. She even changes the chemical blend through the night to match which moths are flying.
Would you fall for a trap that smelled like a mate? Tell us below.
first_comment: The bristly cutworm moth makes up about two thirds of what this spider eats. Would you rather be the spider or the moth?
